title: Majesty
lyrics_original: Unto Jesus be all glory, honor and praise!
Flow from His throne, unto His own
So exalt, lift up on high the Name of Jesus!
Magnify, come glorify, Christ Jesus the King.
Jesus who died, now glorified, King of all kings!
Unto Jesus be all glory, honor and praise
Flow from His throne, unto His own
So exalt, lift up on high the Name of Jesus
Magnify, come glorify, Christ Jesus the King.
Jesus who died, now glorified, King of all kings!

bible_verses.english: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”

Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name; that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, might, honor, glory, and blessing!”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I bow my heart before Your throne today in humble adoration. You are the King of kings, exalted above every name, yet You drew near to save me through Your selfless love. Fill my heart with awe as I worship You, and let my life reflect Your majestic beauty. May all glory, honor, and praise be Yours forever. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: "Majesty" invites us into the breathtaking reality of who Jesus truly is—our reigning King and glorified Savior. When we sing of His kingdom authority, we are reminded that the One who holds all power is the very same Jesus who poured out His life for us on the cross. As we lift high His name today, our humble worship aligns our hearts with the heavenly song of praise. Let us step into His presence with joy, giving Him the honor, glory, and adoration He so richly deserves.
